rationale: Two blocking issues identified and fixed before merge: (1) folder-assigned chats appearing in Recent — restored !chat.folder || chat.isWorkflow filter in ChatSidebarLists.tsx; (2) duplicate getChatBEMessageIndex in store/utils/chats.ts — removed and replaced with re-export from utils/chatHelpers.ts. The Popup native-dialog rewrite, store bug fixes (chatsStore.chats indexing, isGroup), and avatar/tooltip changes are all correct and well-structured. Remaining findings are low-severity style items that do not block merge.

business_review.criterion: Chats sidebar shows Pinned, Recent, and Folders as independent collapsible sections.
business_review.notes: Three independent booleans (isPinnedExpanded, isRecentExpanded, isFoldersExpanded) replace the old single activeSection string. Each section collapses and expands independently.

business_review.criterion: Folder-assigned chats appear only inside their folder, not in Recent.
business_review.notes: Fixed: restored !chat.folder || chat.isWorkflow guard in ChatSidebarLists.tsx forEach. Folder-assigned chats no longer appear in Recent.

business_review.criterion: Chat list items show per-item Avatar/AvatarGroup instead of generic type icons.
business_review.notes: ChatListItem.tsx replaces workflow/group SVG icons with Avatar and AvatarGroup components resolved via useChatItemAvatar hook.

business_review.criterion: Folder headers show a deduplicated AvatarGroup of assistants in the folder.
business_review.notes: FolderList.tsx builds a seen-Set-deduplicated avatar list per folder. hideAvatar suppresses individual chat avatars when all chats share one assistant.

business_review.criterion: New Chat modal allows searching and selecting an assistant to start a chat.
business_review.notes: StartNewChatModal.tsx provides debounced search, recent assistants, and pinned assistants sections with skeleton loading and empty state.

business_review.criterion: Popup component uses native <dialog> API with focus-trap and scroll-lock.
business_review.notes: Popup.tsx fully replaces PrimeReact Dialog with a native <dialog> element. Focus-trap, scroll-lock, backdrop-click, and Escape handling are all implemented.

standards_review.notes: All commits follow EPMCDME-13270: Capital sentence pattern.

ChatSidebarLists.test.tsx covers folder/recent switching and date sorting. Missing: Pinned section tests, imperative ref methods (expandFolder, scrollToChat), StartNewChatModal, Popup native-dialog rewrite, DeleteChatPopup delete+navigate logic.
No XSS risk — chat/folder names rendered as React text content. Backdrop-click uses getBoundingClientRect and is not spoofable. No new unauthenticated API surface.

findings.title: Folder chats appear in Recent — missing !chat.folder filter
findings.description: The forEach at lines 103-114 pushed all non-pinned chats into recentChats regardless of folder assignment.
findings.fix: Restored !chat.folder || chat.isWorkflow guard in the forEach.

findings.title: getChatBEMessageIndex duplicated in store/utils/chats.ts and utils/chatHelpers.ts
findings.description: Identical implementation in two files — could silently diverge.
findings.fix: Removed duplicate from store/utils/chats.ts; replaced with re-export from @/utils/chatHelpers.

findings.title: triggerRef captures document.activeElement at visible=false→true which may be wrong element
findings.description: The effect capturing triggerRef fires on every visible change. At visible=false→true, document.activeElement may be inside a previously opened popup rather than the actual button that triggered this one.
findings.recommendation: Accept the trigger element as a ref prop instead of capturing document.activeElement inside the effect.

findings.title: candidateNext fallback resolves to folderChats[0] which may be the chat being deleted
findings.description: When the deleted chat is the last item, candidateNextIndex is out of bounds and falls back to folderChats[0]. If the folder has only one chat, folderChats[0] is the chat being deleted. The live-store chats.find then returns undefined and the fallback navigates to chats[0] — acceptable but fragile.
findings.recommendation: Filter out the deleted chat id before computing the fallback: const candidates = folderChats.filter(c => c.id !== id).

findings.title: JSON.stringify in useMemo dependency array
findings.description: JSON.stringify(folders) is called on every render before React checks dependencies. Replace with folders directly — it is already a stable memoised reference.

findings.title: Double overflow-auto class
findings.description: Both overflow-auto and overflow-y-auto are applied. overflow-auto already covers both axes; overflow-y-auto is redundant.

findings.title: Off-by-one in name truncation: < should be <=
findings.description: When chatName.length === MAX_NAME_LENGTH (exactly 50 chars), the name is sliced and '...' appended unnecessarily.

findings.title: getChatAssistantIds defined inside render loop
findings.description: Pure function with no closures is re-created on every folders.map iteration.
findings.recommendation: Move outside the component or outside the map callback.

findings.title: Pinned section, imperative ref, and handleMoveChat not tested
findings.description: isPinnedExpanded behavior, expandFolder/scrollToChat imperative handle, and section switching after moveChat are untested.
findings.recommendation: Add tests for pin auto-expand, scrollToChat, and handleMoveChat section transition.

findings.title: StartNewChatModal has no tests
findings.description: New component with search, debounce, recent/pinned sections, skeleton, and empty state — all untested.
findings.recommendation: Add unit tests covering search debounce, section rendering, and startNewChat call arguments.
